blends.name: Gem Shard Blend
blends.desc:
Gather the magic of the dungeon with 5 Gem Shards to craft a powerful, radiant gem! Use this blend to unlock one of six unique and valuable gems with the following chances:

Emerald: 27%
Ruby: 22%
Diamond: 4%
Sapphire: 10%
Topaz: 18%
Amethyst: 19%

blends.name: Amethyst Upgrade: Flawless to Perfect
blends.desc: Achieve the highest level of material mining by blending three Flawless Amethysts into a Perfect Amethyst. This ultimate upgrade offers maximum mining power, but with a 10% failure rate, it challenges Miners to reach their full potential.

blends.name: Amethyst Upgrade: Normal to Flawless
blends.desc:
Transform three Normal Amethysts into a Flawless Amethyst, significantly boosting material mining when equipped with the Miner's set. This blend has a 10% failure rate, making it a rewarding but risky choice for dedicated Miners.

Miners set has not been released yet.

blends.name: Amethyst Upgrade: Flawed to Normal
blends.desc: Merge three Flawed Amethysts into a Normal Amethyst, elevating your material mining bonus with the Miner's set. This blend has a 10% failure rate, adding a slight challenge for Miners seeking enhanced yields.

blends.name: Amethyst Upgrade: Chipped to Flawed
blends.desc:
Combine three Chipped Amethysts to form a Flawed Amethyst, enhancing material mining with the Miner's set. This blend has a 100% success rate, providing a secure pathway to higher mining capabilities.

Miner set has not been released yet.

blends.name: Topaz Upgrade: Flawless to Perfect
blends.desc: Achieve the pinnacle of wealth by blending three Flawless Topaz into a Perfect Topaz. This final upgrade offers the maximum token bonus, yet it comes with a 25% failure rate, challenging players to reach the top.

blends.name: Topaz Upgrade: Normal to Flawless
blends.desc: Transform three Normal Topaz into a Flawless Topaz, enhancing your token bonus to a high level with the Banker’s set. This blend comes with a 20% failure rate, adding a layer of risk as you pursue greater prosperity.

blends.name: Topaz Upgrade: Flawed to Normal
blends.desc: Blend three Flawed Topaz into a Normal Topaz, increasing your token bonus with the Banker’s set. This blend has a 10% failure rate, making it a careful choice for those looking to grow their earnings potential.

blends.name: Topaz Upgrade: Chipped to Flawed
blends.desc: Combine three Chipped Topaz to create a Flawed Topaz, boosting token earnings when used with the Banker’s set. This blend has a 100% success rate, providing a secure step towards higher rewards. Upgrade is unlockable with starting from Normal gems.

blends.name: Sapphire Upgrade: Flawless to Perfect
blends.desc:
Reach peak speed by blending three Flawless Sapphires into a Perfect Sapphire. This final upgrade offers the ultimate agility boost but comes with a 30% failure rate, creating a challenging path to the top.

Faster than fast, quicker than quick.

blends.name: Sapphire Upgrade: Normal to Flawless
blends.desc: Combine three Normal Sapphires to achieve a Flawless Sapphire, granting a high speed boost with the Sprinter’s set. Be cautious, as there is a 20% failure rate, making this blend a choice for those seeking a swift advantage.

blends.name: Sapphire Upgrade: Flawed to Normal
blends.desc: Blend three Flawed Sapphires into a Normal Sapphire for a more noticeable speed boost with the Sprinter’s set. This blend carries a 10% failure rate, adding a slight risk as you reach for greater acceleration.

blends.name: Sapphire Upgrade: Chipped to Flawed
blends.desc: Combine three Chipped Sapphires to form a Flawed Sapphire, enhancing your speed with the Sprinter’s set. This blend has a 100% success rate, ensuring a reliable path to upgrade in agility.

blends.name: Diamond Upgrade: Flawless to Perfect
blends.desc:
Achieve the pinnacle of contribution power by blending three Flawless Diamonds into a Perfect Diamond. This final blend has a 35% chance of failure, making it a high-stakes choice for those seeking elite boosts in Contribution Points.

Do you have what it takes to achieve greatness?

blends.name: Diamond Upgrade: Normal to Flawless
blends.desc: Combine three Normal Diamonds to upgrade to a Flawless Diamond, offering a high Contribution Points boost. With a 25% failure rate, blending at this level requires careful consideration for maximum rewards.

blends.name: Diamond Upgrade: Flawed to Normal
blends.desc: Blend three Flawed Diamonds into a Normal Diamond for a significant contribution boost with the Cook’s set. This blend has a 15% failure rate, so there’s a small risk involved in reaching this enhanced level.

blends.name: Diamond Upgrade: Chipped to Flawed
blends.desc: Combine three Chipped Diamonds to form a Flawed Diamond, enhancing your Contribution Points with the Cook’s set. This blend is guaranteed to succeed with a 100% success rate, making it a reliable gem for culinary mastery.

blends.name: Ruby Upgrade: Flawless to Perfect
blends.desc: Unlock the ultimate NFT boost by blending three Flawless Rubies to form a Perfect Ruby. With a 10% failure rate, this blend offers the highest rewards for collectors willing to take the leap.

blends.name: Ruby Upgrade: Normal to Flawless
blends.desc: Merge three Normal Rubies to achieve a Flawless Ruby, bringing a significant boost to NFT finds with the Collector’s set. This blend comes with a 10% chance of failure, so blend wisely to maximize your gains.

blends.name: Ruby Upgrade: Flawed to Normal
blends.desc: Elevate your NFT drop rates by blending three Flawed Rubies into a Normal Ruby. This blend has a 10% failure rate, adding a touch of risk to the process as you increase your Collector's potential.

blends.name: Ruby Upgrade: Chipped to Flawed
blends.desc: Combine three Chipped Rubies to forge a Flawed Ruby, enhancing your NFT drop rate with the Collector’s set. This blend has a 100% success rate, this could be a reliable boost for your collecting adventures.

blends.name: Emerald Upgrade: Flawless to Perfect"
blends.desc: Achieve the pinnacle of XP boosts with a Perfect Emerald! Blend three Flawless Emeralds to obtain this ultimate gem. Note that this blend has a 10% chance of failure, so proceed strategically to unlock the maximum boost potential for your Professor’s tools.

blends.name: Emerald Upgrade: Normal to Flawless
blends.desc: Refine your Normal Emeralds into a Flawless Emerald by blending three of the same type. This blend provides a higher XP boost, ideal for experienced Professors. Be aware of a 10% failure rate on this blend.

blends.name: Emerald Upgrade: Flawed to Normal
blends.desc: Combine three Flawed Emeralds to create a Normal Emerald, amplifying your XP boost for the Professor’s set. Note that this blend has a 10% chance of failure, so plan your upgrades with care for the best outcomes.

blends.name: Emerald Upgrade: Chipped to Flawed
blends.desc: Take your Chipped Emeralds to the next level by blending three together to form a Flawed Emerald! This blend has a 100% success rate, ensuring a steady step forward in gaining XP boosts for your Professor’s set.
